value.rationale: The source leaves a genuine model-specific high-degree stability condition unanalyzed. Solving its sign on a structurally meaningful feasible asymmetric equilibrium curve yields an all-ratio exact two-crossing classification and rigorous rational-parameter example; the finite instability window challenges monotone control interpretations. Significance is mathematical stability of an explicit epidemic-opinion model rather than claims about empirical epidemic predictions.
